projects.description: Create a real-time AI based solution for a major automobile manufacturer to serve knowledge documents to Contact Center Agents based on on-going conversation with customer.  I developed the UI and Node.js back end to consume messages from RabbitMQ and route to appropriate desktop. Document titles would show up on the side bar, and on click, would open the entire document in a tabbed interface. UI was made with AngularJS and UIBootstrap. Socket.io was used to communicate between browser and Node.js server over HTTPS

projects.name: Sensor Configuration Visualizer
projects.description: Full-Stack application for an IoT Company in the maritime domain to visualize sensor configuration changes across time. Application was developed using Angular 2+, Carbon Design System, and  D3.js for full-custom visualization inspired by ObservableHQ. Backend developed with Node.js as orchestration layer and MongoDB to store configurations.

projects.name: Data Pipeline Resolution With Rich Jira API, Automation and Email Integration
projects.description: Full-Stack application for an IoT Company in the maritime domain to improve resolution time and track accountability for data availability issues. Jira wrapper created to manage costs by enabling multiple users across one paid account. Front-End Application was developed using Angular 2+, Angular Material. Backend developed with Nest.js (opinionated Node.js framework) as orchestration layer and MySQL to store configurations. 2 microservices, one for ticket creation and one for automated pre-checks to populate certain fields and email alerts. Complete use-case specific Jira workflow created, and Jira Automations also configured for certain ticket updates.

projects.name: Platform Configuration with Complex Client State Management and Checkpoints
projects.description: Front-End application for an IoT Company in the maritime domain to manage configuration of Ocean Platforms. Application was developed using Angular 2+, Carbon Design System. Error and loading states, race conditions, selective auto roll-backs on failed updates implemented. Client-side API calls optimized by tracking incremental changes to state.

projects.name: Angular App Upgrades and Optimizations.
projects.description: Updated applications across multiple versions of Angular to fix security issues and deprecated packages. Deprecated packages replaced with lighter, more secure alternatives. Bundle sizes reduced by 80%, and performance improved using lazy loading, complexity reduction, library replacements, good import practices etc.
